{{Short description|Spanish applied mathematician}}
{{Family name hatnote|lang=Spanish|Vázquez|Cendón}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=August 2021}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=August 2021}}
'''María Elena Vázquez Cendón''' is a Spanish applied mathematician specializing in the use of [[differential equation]]s to model [[waves and shallow water]], and in the use of [[finite volume method]]s and [[upwind scheme]]s to compute numerical solutions to these differential equations and other [[hyperbolic partial differential equation]]s.{{r|cedya}} She is a professor of applied mathematics and dean of mathematics at the [[University of Santiago de Compostela]].{{r|dean}}

==Education and career==
Vázquez was born in [[Ourense]] in 1966. After studying mathematics at the 
I.E.S As Lagoas in Ourense, she did her undergraduate and graduate studies at the [[University of Santiago de Compostela]],{{r|scq}} completing a Ph.D. in 1994 with the dissertation ''Estudio de esquemas descentrados para su aplicación a las leyes de conservación con términos fuente'' supervised by Alfredo Bermúdez de Castro.{{r|mg}}

She is a professor of applied mathematics at the University of Santiago de Compostela,{{r|profile}} where she has worked since 1989; additionally, she became a research associate for the Technical Institute for Industrial Mathematics in 2013.{{r|cedya}} At the University of Santiago de Compostela, she has been dean of the faculty of mathematics since 2017, and was re-elected as dean in 2021.{{r|dean}} She has also served as vice rector of the university.{{r|scq}}

==Books==
Vázquez is the author of ''Solving Hyperbolic Equations with Finite Volume Methods'', Springer, 2015 (translated from a Spanish edition published in 2008).{{r|she}} She is the editor of ''Lecture Notes on Numerical Methods for Hyperbolic Equations'' (CRC Press, 2011).
